caption: The drawing depicts two gray oxen harnessed side by side with brown wooden yokes attached to their necks, pulling a covered wagon. The wagon has four greenish wooden wheels, green structural undercarriage, and a tan canvas cover stretched over a rounded wooden frame. The oxen are positioned at the left side of the image, facing to the right, while the covered wagon occupies the right half of the drawing. The canvas cover is tightly draped, with visible seams and curves, and the wagon has reinforcing wooden beams and small details, such as bolts or nails, painted along its sides. The background is a plain, unadorned light beige.
title: Miniature Oxcart
